title: Run acknowledgement
description: IAC-2: what the customer was told before a run could start, and who accepted it. The tool used to GUESS which machines were managed by infrastructure-as-code, from a handful of tags, and stop those machines. It cannot tell Terraform from Bicep, Pulumi, ARM or Ansible, so it now tells the customer once, plainly, and records that a named person accepted it. Held as a run artifact rather than a wizard checkbox so the ENGINE can require it - an acknowledgement only the UI enforces is bypassed by anyone using the API.

topic.description: What was acknowledged. An enum so a future acknowledgement cannot be silently satisfied by an unrelated one.

acknowledgedBy.description: The signed-in identity that accepted it. Not a free-text name - this is the audit trail.

statement.description: The exact words the person was shown, stored with the acceptance. If the wording changes later, the record still says what THIS person agreed to.
